title: Election Commission begins staff training for SIR in Punjab
summary: The Election Commission has started staff training programmes across Punjab to prepare officials for conducting the Scheduled Impartial Reporting (SIR) process.
digest: The Election Commission of India has initiated training sessions for staff members throughout Punjab. The training focuses on procedures and protocols for Scheduled Impartial Reporting (SIR), a key electoral mechanism. The programme aims to ensure poll officials are adequately prepared to implement these guidelines during elections.

title: Kiwi’s FIFA World Cup call-up kicks up joy in Punjab
summary: A footballer of New Zealand origin has received a FIFA World Cup call-up, triggering celebrations and pride among Punjabi communities.
digest: A New Zealand-origin player has been selected for FIFA World Cup squad, generating joy and celebrations in Punjab. The player's selection is viewed as a matter of pride for Punjabi diaspora and communities. The call-up reflects representation of Punjab-connected athletes in international football competition.
